pr_title: List each lens's outcome in the order the lenses ran, and move the log tail

comments.comment: The lens task's result changes from an object keyed by lens to an array with no new task version, so failedLenses throws on a finished lens task an older Melian stored, which a repeat review attaches to.
comments.failureScenario: Melian before this change reviews head H and stores lens task T's result as { "correctness@v1": { status: "done" } }. After the upgrade, a repeat review of H attaches to T, and failedLenses calls outcome.result.flatMap on that stored object, which throws TypeError: outcome.result.flatMap is not a function, so every repeat review of a head reviewed before the upgrade fails.

comments.comment: tail slices from a negative index when the log is shorter than count, so it drops the first lines instead of returning the whole log.
comments.failureScenario: tail("a\nb\nc", 5) computes lines.slice(3 - 5), that is slice(-2), and returns ["b", "c"], where the doc comment says a log shorter than count lines comes back whole as ["a", "b", "c"].
